items.control_name: Enforce Azure CAF Enterprise-Scale Management Group Hierarchy
items.description: The Azure tenant must deploy standardized Management Groups: Platform (Identity, Connectivity, Management), LandingZones (Prod, Non-Prod), and Decommissioned.
items.current_value: Enterprise-Scale Management Group hierarchy deployed under 'mg-enterprise-root'
items.recommended_value: Standardized CAF Enterprise-Scale hierarchy with policy inheritance
items.remediation_notes: Verify no resources or subscriptions exist directly under the Root Management Group.

items.control_name: Enforce Hub-and-Spoke / Azure Virtual WAN Centralized Transit Architecture
items.description: Spoke VNets in Landing Zone subscriptions must connect to a centralized Connectivity Hub VNet/vWAN with Azure Firewall inspection.
items.current_value: 14 spoke VNets peered to 'vnet-hub-prod' with forced tunneling through Azure Firewall
items.recommended_value: 100% of spoke VNets connected to Connectivity Hub with zero direct internet egress
items.remediation_notes: Audit User Defined Routes (UDRs) on spoke subnets for 0.0.0.0/0 pointing to firewall IP.

items.control_name: Enforce Subscription Democratization via Azure Landing Zone Vendoring
items.description: Workloads must be separated into dedicated subscriptions per application/environment to isolate blast radiuses and billing.
items.recommended_value: 100% workload isolation via dedicated Landing Zone subscriptions
items.remediation_notes: Use Azure Blueprints or Bicep modules for subscription vending.

items.control_name: Enforce Dedicated Management Subscription for Central Log Analytics Workspace
items.description: Security logs and Sentinel SIEM must reside in a dedicated Management/Platform subscription with restricted Entra ID RBAC.
items.recommended_value: Dedicated platform management subscription with least-privilege SOC access
items.remediation_notes: Enforce MFA and PIM JIT for any write operations to the Management subscription.
